blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Thailand’s Sasiwararin Atsawahirankarn was crowned Miss Asia Pacific International 2026, capping weeks of pageant activities that took the candidates on tours across the province. She emerged victorious over 37 other candidates representing countries and territories worldwide, succeeding Brazil’s Isabela Fernandes at the coronation night held at Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City […]...
